project.title: Café Exterior Photography
project.description: A study of exterior details through photography, focusing on the café's wall, textures, and visual elements. By highlighting the smaller details of the building rather than its interior, this photograph explores how architectural features can create visual interest and give a place its own character.

project.title: Church Bell Tower Photography
project.description: A photograph of a church bell tower captured from below, emphasizing its height, structure, and architectural details. This perspective draws the viewer's attention upward, offering a distinctive view of the tower and highlighting the craftsmanship of the church's design.

project.title: Horse Photography in Intramuros
project.description: A photograph of a horse taken in Intramuros, a historic district in Manila. With the historical surroundings in the background, the image evokes the role horses played in transportation and daily life in earlier periods. It connects the subject to the area's historical atmosphere, showing how photography can capture details that invite viewers to reflect on the past.
